input.quote: 9.3 Customer may terminate an Order Form immediately if Vendor suffers a material Security Incident, repeatedly misses a critical service level, violates Applicable Law in performing the Services, or infringes a third party's intellectual property and cannot provide the remedies required by Section 20.5.
input.rationale: There is no indemnification clause anywhere in the Agreement: the numbering jumps from Section 19 (Warranties) to Section 21 (Limitation of Liability), and searches for "indemnify", "hold harmless", "defend", and infringement remedies return no operative grant. Sections 9.3 ("remedies required by Section 20.5"), 19.4, 19.5, 21.3, 29.2, and 30.5 all presuppose indemnification obligations and indemnified parties that the document never creates, so Customer has no Vendor IP or misconduct indemnity — walk-away territory. We insert a new Section 20.1 at the preferred level (Vendor defence/indemnity for Services and Deliverables IP infringement, Vendor's breach of Applicable Law, Vendor-caused unauthorized access to Customer Data, and gross negligence/wilful misconduct, with notice, control of defence, and cooperation) and cap any Customer indemnity at Customer-provided content and Customer's breach of law. We deliberately did not take the fallback: its 3× annual fees super-cap would be worse for us than Section 21.3, which already treats indemnification obligations as uncapped Excluded Claims.

proposal.summary: Insert missing Section 20 Vendor indemnity (IP, breach of law, data breach, gross negligence/wilful misconduct) with notice/control/cooperation procedure and a narrow Customer indemnity limit.
proposal.comment: [Playbook] The Agreement has no indemnity section at all (Section 9.3 already assumes one by referring to "Section 20.5"), so we have inserted the standard Vendor defence and indemnity for third-party IP, breach-of-law, Vendor-caused data breach, and gross negligence/wilful misconduct claims, with the usual notice, control-of-defence, and cooperation mechanics, and confirmed that any Customer indemnity is limited to Customer-provided content and Customer's breach of Applicable Law.

ops.text: Vendor shall defend, indemnify, and hold harmless Customer and its Affiliates from and against any third-party claim, and all resulting damages, costs, and expenses (including reasonable attorneys' fees), to the extent arising out of (a) an allegation that the Services or Deliverables infringe or misappropriate any intellectual property right; (b) Vendor's breach of Applicable Law; (c) any unauthorized access to, or disclosure of, Customer Data caused by Vendor; or (d) Vendor's gross negligence or wilful misconduct. Customer shall give Vendor written notice of the claim, Vendor shall control its defence and settlement, and Customer shall provide reasonable cooperation. Customer's indemnification obligations under this Agreement are limited to third-party claims arising from Customer-provided content and Customer's breach of Applicable Law.

mappings.element: Vendor has an express duty to defend Customer and its affiliates.
Vendor indemnifies Customer and its affiliates against third-party claims.
Vendor indemnity covers claims that Services or Deliverables infringe intellectual property rights.
Vendor indemnity covers Vendor's breach of applicable law.
Vendor indemnity covers a data breach caused by Vendor.
Vendor indemnity covers Vendor's gross negligence and wilful misconduct.
The indemnification procedure requires notice of a claim.
The indemnification procedure allocates control of the defence.
The indemnification procedure requires reasonable cooperation.
Customer indemnity is limited to Customer-provided content and Customer's breach of law.
